work.title: FedEx USPS Cross
work.description: Wall-mounted relief sculpture assembled from FedEx and USPS shipping envelopes and cardboard panels, arranged in a cross-like geometric formation with navy stripe accents. Small decorative floral fasteners punctuate the junctions of layered white panels throughout the composition.
work.composition: cruciform layered relief on neutral ground
keywords: navy stripe layered panel wall work
